column1: # What the differential test compares, and where each file came from.
# Columns: role, source (commit:path, or the path in this repo), sha256 of the bytes.
# v0.1.0 (commit e1e72ba, tag object c315d5b) is the newest published build and the only one. The
# repo publishes v* releases only, no dev pre-release, and no predecessor repo shipped this mod. It
# pinned core 992b910. src/config.cpp, src/config.h, src/config_sanitize.h and src/logging.h are
# byte for byte the same at v0.1.0 and at 5bf6f0c, the commit the reader was frozen at, and every
# core source either reader compiles holds the same bytes at 992b910 and at the current pin, so
# v0.1.0's release ZIP and launcher-manifest.json shipped no HeadTracking.ini and seeded none: its
# first start wrote it from kDefaultIniText in src/config.cpp. That text, extracted once, is the
# first-run input. The repo's HeadTracking.ini has one committed version, e7976fd, unchanged
# through v0.1.0, and it holds the same bytes, so it is the same input.

column2: kDefaultIniText at v0.1.0, what its first start wrote, and e7976fd:HeadTracking.ini: data/firstrun-v0.1.0.ini
